meta.themes: Frontier Agent Models Expand, AI Business Signals Diverge, Custom Inference Infrastructure Scales, Agent Evaluation Becomes Operational

news.title: Meta released Muse Wonder models for agentic work
news.summary: Meta introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full with active memory, error recovery, and frontier coding capabilities for personal and professional agent tasks.

news.title: Google made Gemini 4 Argon broadly available
news.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Argon for long, multi-step enterprise work through Gemini for business, its API, AI Studio, and the Antigravity developer platform.

news.title: OpenAI opened a sponsored GPT-Rosalind plan for academic labs
news.summary: OpenAI launched the Rosalind Academic Plan with up to 30 free seats for eligible US university labs using its specialized life-sciences model and workbench.

news.title: Character.AI filed for bankruptcy and agreed to a Disney asset sale
news.summary: Character.AI entered Chapter 11 with a $20 million Disney bid for some assets after legal, regulatory, and operating pressures left the chatbot company deeply unprofitable.

news.title: GTCR and Elliott agreed to acquire CCC for $6.1 billion
news.summary: GTCR and Elliott agreed to buy insurance AI platform CCC Intelligent Solutions for about $6.1 billion, with plans to accelerate its AI and agentic capabilities.

news.title: Abu Dhabi formed TAMM Global to export its AI government platform
news.summary: Abu Dhabi established TAMM Global as a private-sector company that will license its AI-powered government services platform and operating model internationally.

news.title: Microsoft set Azure Maia for multi-gigawatt deployment
news.summary: Microsoft said Maia 200 is serving production AI workloads and Maia 300 will begin 2027 deployments with a target of 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems.

news.title: Intel detailed its GPU D-series for large-scale inference
news.summary: Intel detailed an air-cooled 350-watt GPU D-series design with up to 480 GB of memory for sustained inference, long contexts, and concurrent agent workloads.

news.title: Britain moved to strengthen defenses against advanced AI risks
news.summary: The UK announced expanded frontier-model evaluations, cyber-defense pilots, possible legal protections, and incident planning for failures involving autonomous AI agents.

news.title: GitHub made agentic code-scanning autofix generally available
news.summary: GitHub's agentic autofix can investigate code-scanning alerts, generate and validate fixes with CodeQL, and open reviewable draft pull requests for enterprise customers.

news.title: Google shared four evaluation lessons from building agent plugins
news.summary: Google advised agent builders to score tool-call trajectories, preserve asynchronous turn structure, compare live and plan-only runs, and maintain expert golden sets.

news.title: AWS published a nine-stage production agent evaluation framework
news.summary: AWS described a nine-stage AgentCore evaluation loop spanning golden sets, CI and deployment gates, canaries, adversarial tests, drift monitoring, and automated feedback.
